description: What each language needs (cell, deps file, generator, sync rule, wrapper rule, watch files) is spread over flake-parts:278-354, buck2.nix:434-487/649-718/764-781, direnv-lib.nix, options.nix, nix/buck2/*-deps-cell.nix and tw's hard-coded map (src/cmd/tw/main.go:41-64). Drift already causes a bug: the uv wrapper watches uv.lock but the python rule regenerates from pylock.toml with no uv export in between. Collapse into one description per language, iterated by every consumer; tw reads wrapper rules from sync.toml.
title: One language module owns 'language X is enabled'
